column1: # Vantage baked-in setting defaults, applied to Settings.java at BUILD time by
# Settings.java itself stays byte-identical to upstream so the nightly sync never
# conflicts on it. Columns are TAB separated: setting key, upstream default, Vantage default.
# The script fails the build unless `("<key>", <upstream default>` occurs exactly once,
# so an upstream rename or default change is caught loudly instead of silently dropped.
